import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    static class Matrix {
        long[][] a;

        Matrix(int size) {
            a = new long[size][size];
        }
    }

    static Matrix multiplyMatrices(Matrix A, Matrix B, int size) {
        Matrix C = new Matrix(size);
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                C.a[i][j] = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < size; k++) {
                    C.a[i][j] = (C.a[i][j] + A.a[i][k] * B.a[k][j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        return C;
    }

    static Matrix powerMatrix(Matrix base, long exp, int size) {
        Matrix result = new Matrix(size);
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                result.a[i][j] = (i == j) ? 1 : 0;
            }
        }
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = multiplyMatrices(result, base, size);
            }
            base = multiplyMatrices(base, base, size);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();

        long tmp = n;
        java.util.List<Long> digits = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        while (tmp > 0) {
            digits.add(tmp % m);
            tmp /= m;
        }

        int cnt = digits.size();

        Matrix[][] f = new Matrix[75][35];
        for (int i = 0; i < 75; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 35; j++) {
                f[i][j] = new Matrix(m + 1);
            }
        }

        Matrix[] pre = new Matrix[m];
        Matrix[] suf = new Matrix[m];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                f[0][i].a[j][i] = 1;
                f[0][i].a[j][j] = 1;
            }
        }

        Matrix g = new Matrix(m + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
            g.a[0][i] = 0;
        }
        g.a[0][m] = 1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) {
            int idx = cnt - i;
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                if (i == 1 && j == 0) {
                    pre[j] = f[idx][0];
                } else {
                    pre[j] = multiplyMatrices(pre[j - 1], f[idx][j], m);
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                if (j == m - 1) {
                    suf[j] = f[idx][j];
                } else {
                    suf[j] = multiplyMatrices(f[idx][j], suf[j + 1], m);
                }
            }
            f[idx + 1][0] = suf[0];
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                f[idx + 1][j] = multiplyMatrices(suf[j], pre[j - 1], m);
            }
        }

        int cur = 0;
        for (int i = cnt - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            long digit = digits.get(i);
            while (digit-- > 0) {
                g = multiplyMatrices(g, f[i][cur], m);
                cur = (cur + 1) % m;
            }
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
            ans = (ans + g.a[0][i]) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
